what_this_is: The commit that closes each v0.8e item, so its handoff archive can be built from the tree as that item left it. E3's archive was taken when its slice closed and is not rebuilt here; E1's and E2's were never taken, which is the omission E4 exists to make impossible. E4's names the commit that implements it, because the manifest entry recording an archive cannot live inside the commit that archive is built from -- the same closure boundary the reserve documents for a volume that cannot contain its own final hash.
